title: Behavioral Challenge
description: Answer a behavioral interview question with situation, action and result.
scenario: A hiring manager asks about a difficult professional situation.
initial_question: Tell me about a difficult challenge at work and how you handled it.
transfer_question: Describe a different situation where you influenced people without authority.
language_policy: Tutor speaks concise English and accepts English learner responses.
correction_policy: Select one primary and at most one distinct secondary correction.
completion_rules: First attempt, retry, transfer, evidence, summary and review.
prompt_context: Keep the example specific and end with a measurable or observable result.
